def solve_pair(p):

    O={(i,j) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if go[i][j]==8}
    Cs=comps(gi)
    # two largest comps
    Cs.sort(key=lambda c:-len(c[1]))
    A=set(cs[0][1]); B=set(cs[1][1])
    hits=[]
    for dy in range(-22,23):
        for dx in range(-22,23):
            Mt=B
            # candidate ops on overlapping/non-overlapping regions with various crops
            P=A^Mt
            uy=min(y for y,_ in P); ux=min(x for _,x in P)
            h=max(y for y,_ in P)-uy+1; w=max(x for _,x in P)-ux+1
            mk=tuple(sorted((y-uy,x-ux) for y,x in P))
            if (h,w)==(len(O),max(j for _,j in O)+1) and set(mk)==O: hits.append(('xor',dy,dx))
            P=A&Mt
            uy=min(y for y,_ in P); ux=min(x for _,x in P)
            h=max(y for y,_ in P)-uy+1; w=max(x for _,x in P)-ux+1
            mk=tuple(sorted((y-uy,x-ux) for y,x in P))
            if (h,w)==(len(O),max(j for _,j in O)+1) and set(mk)==O: hits.append(('and',dy,dx))
            P=A|Mt
            uy=min(y for y,_ in P); ux=min(x for _,x in P)
            h=max(y for y,_ in P)-uy+1; w=max(x for _,x in P)-ux+1
            mk=tuple(sorted((y-uy,x-ux) for y,x in P))
            if (h,w)==(len(O),max(j for _,j in O)+1) and set(mk)==O: hits.append(('or',dy,dx))
            P=Mt-A
            uy=min(y for y,_ in P); ux=min(x for _,x in P)
            h=max(y for y,_ in P)-uy+1; w=max(x for _,x in P)-ux+1
            mk=tuple(sorted((y-uy,x-ux) for y,x in P))
            if (h,w)==(len(O),max(j for _,j in O)+1) and set(mk)==O: hits.append(('Aminus',dy,dx))
            P=A-Mt
            uy=min(y for y,_ in P); ux=min(x for _,x in P)
            h=max(y for y,_ in P)-uy+1; w=max(x for _,x in P)-ux+1
            mk=tuple(sorted((y-uy,x-ux) for y,x in P))
            if (h,w)==(len(O),max(j for _,j in O)+1) and set(mk)==O: hits.append(('Bminus',dy,dx))
    return hits,O

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for p in [1,2,3]:
    g=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts={(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if g[y][x]}
    # use 8-connectivity to keep motif shapes together
    seen=set(); Cs=[]
    for start in sorted(pts):
        if start in seen: continue
        st=[start]; comp=set()
        while st:
            y,x=st.pop()
            if (y,x) in comp: continue
            comp.add((y,x))
            for dy in (-1,0,1):
                for dx in (-1,0,1):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==g[y][x] and (ny,nx) not in comp:
                        st.append((ny,nx))
        Cs.append(comp); seen|=comp
    Cs=[c for c in Cs if len(c)>=5]
    Cs.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    A,B=Cs[0],Cs[1]
    minya=min(y for y,_ in A); minxa=min(x for _,x in A)
    minyb=min(y for y,_ in B); minxb=min(x for _,x in B)
    a={(y-minya,x-minxa) for y,x in A}; b={(y-minyb,x-minxb) for y,x in B}
    h=max(y for y,_ in A)-minya+1; w=max(x for _,x in A)-minxa+1
    N=a&b; uy=min(y for y,_ in N); ux=min(x for _,x in N)
    print('demo',p,'A size',len(A),'B size',len(B),'normA bbox',(h,w))
    print(' overlap normalized:',sorted(N))
    go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    o={(i,j) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if go[i][j]==8}
    ho=min(y for y,_ in o); hxo=min(x for _,x in o)
    oo=sorted((y-ho,x-hxo) for y,x in o)
    print(' output norm:',oo)

def solve_pair(p):
    g=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    # find motif: connected same-color components >=4, take two largest by bounding box? Use the 16-cell and 8-cell comps (exact copies).
    Cs=comps(g)
    cs=[S for c,S in Cs if len(S)>=4]
    cs.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    A,B=cs[0],cs[1]
    print('demo',p,'sizes',[len(c) for c in cs[:3]])
    ra=(min(y for y,_ in A),min(x for _,x in A)); rb=(min(y for y,_ in B),min(x for _,x in B))
    print('top-lefts',ra,rb)
    nA={(y-ra[0],x-ra[1]) for y,x in A}; nB={(y-rb[0],x-rb[1]) for y,x in B}
    O={(i,j) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if go[i][j]==8}
    # all pairwise translations of normalized shapes; pick one whose union/intersection matches output norm; search all alignments of B onto A grid space with overlap
    best=None
    for dy in range(-25,26):
        for dx in range(-25,26):
            moved={(y+dy,x+dx) for y,x in nB}
            inter=moved&nA
            if not inter: continue
            eA=nA-moved; eB=moved-nA
            score=min(eA,eB)
            if best is None or score>best[0]: best=(score,moved,inter,eA,eB,(dy,dx))
    sc,move,inter,eA,eB,off=best
    print(' best offset',(off),'symmetric diff:',sorted((y-min(y for y,_ in (eA|eB)),x-min(x for _,x in (eA|eB))) for y,x in eA|eB))
    exp=sorted(O); print(' want:',exp)
